                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Port: `4519` (do not use any other port).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The app must expose the following JSON HTTP API. All request and response bodies are `application/json`. The canonical **poll object** shape used in every response is:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```json\n'[39m +
                [32m'  {\n'[39m +
                [32m'    "id": string,\n'[39m +
                [32m'    "question": string,\n'[39m +
                [32m'    "totalVotes": number,\n'[39m +
                [32m'    "options": [ { "id": string, "text": string, "votes": number } ]\n'[39m +
                [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `POST /api/polls` — create a poll.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'    ```json\n'[39m +
                [32m'    // Request\n'[39m +
                [32m'    { "question": string, "options": string[] }\n'[39m +
                [32m'    ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'    On success return **201** and the created poll object (every option\'s `votes` is `0`, `totalVotes` is `0`; option order matches the request order). If `question` is empty or fewer than 2 non-empty options are provided, return **400** with `{ "error": string }`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `GET /api/polls/:id` — return **200** and the poll object, or **404** with `{ "error": string }` if it does not exist.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `POST /api/polls/:id/vote` — cast a vote.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'    ```json\n'[39m +
                [32m'    // Request\n'[39m +
                [32m'    { "optionId": string }\n'[39m +
                [32m'    ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * If the poll or option does not exist, return **404** with `{ "error": string }`.\n'[39m +
                [32m"    * If the requesting client has **not** yet voted on this poll: increment the chosen option's count, assign/persist the client's identifier via an HTTP cookie (`Set-Cookie` on the response), and return **200** with the updated poll object.\n"[39m +
                [32m'    * If the requesting client has **already** voted on this poll (as identified by its cookie): return **409** with `{ "error": string }` and change no counts.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * A request that arrives with no client-identifier cookie is treated as a brand-new client.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Poll page route: `GET /poll/<id>` must render a full HTML page for the poll with `id` `<id>`. On this page the following DOM contract MUST hold (the grader relies on it):\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A running total element with attribute `data-testid="total-votes"` whose text contains the integer total number of votes for the poll.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * For each option with id `<optionId>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * A clickable vote control with attribute `data-testid="vote-<optionId>"`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * An element with attribute `data-testid="count-<optionId>"` whose text contains that option\'s integer vote count.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * An element with attribute `data-testid="percent-<optionId>"` whose text contains that option\'s percentage of the total as an integer immediately followed by `%` (e.g. `100%`). The percentage is `0` when the total is `0`, otherwise `round(votes / total * 100)`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * When the current client attempts to vote a second time on this poll, an element with attribute `data-testid="vote-error"` becomes visible on the page.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * After any client votes, the counts, percentages, and total shown to every other client currently viewing this poll page must update within 5 seconds **without** that client reloading the page.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Home page route: `GET /` must return **200** and list existing polls, each linking to its `/poll/<id>` page.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The app must run fully offline: only local SQLite / in-memory / local HTTP is allowed. No external APIs or network access.'[39m
            }
